pr_metadata.title: [CHIA-3966] Use singleton struct from singleton instead of DID innerpuz
pr_metadata.description:
<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes how launcher IDs are derived during wallet sync and NFT minter resolution; incorrect paths could mis-identify DIDs or minters, but the approach matches other singleton types in the codebase.
> 
> **Overview**
> DID and NFT wallet parsing no longer takes the **singleton struct** or **launcher ID** from the DID inner puzzle’s curried arguments. Those values now come from the **singleton top-layer** reveal: `singleton_struct` from `uncurried.args.at("f")`, and launcher / minter DID from `uncurried.args.at("frf")`.
> 
> This affects DID coin ingestion (`coin_added`, `determine_coin_type`), manual DID lookup, lost-DID recovery setup, and NFT **minter DID** resolution when tracing bulk-mint lineage through a parent DID spend.
>
